description: This file is a Spring configuration class that sets up the beans and dependencies for an email execution batch job within the Fineract project. It defines beans for the job, its steps, and associated services such as the tasklet, repositories, and validators.

classes.name: ExecuteEmailConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines the batch step and job for executing email campaigns, injecting necessary dependencies and creating beans for the tasklet, step, and job.

methods.name: executeEmailStep
methods.description: Creates a batch Step for executing the email tasklet, using the StepBuilder with dependencies injected.

methods.name: executeEmailJob
methods.description: Defines the batch Job that runs the email execution step, with an incrementer for job instance uniqueness.

methods.name: executeEmailTasklet
methods.description: Constructs the ExecuteEmailTasklet with all required repositories, services, and properties injected.
